name: design-system
description: Design System governance and delivery workflows for multi-framework component systems.

interface.shortDescription: Turn visual and interaction needs into multi-framework Design System changes.
interface.longDescription: Routes Design System work by project role and task mode, keeping tokens, component contracts, framework implementations, conformance, and consumer changes in their correct ownership boundaries.
capabilities: Resolve Design System and consumer project context
Turn non-technical visual and interaction needs into Design System changes
Design and evolve tokens and component contracts
Route React and Blazor implementation work
Coordinate cross-framework conformance and consumer handoffs
defaultPrompt: Use $design-system to describe a Design System need through its visual and interaction experience.
Use $design-system to design a component contract for React and Blazor.
Use $design-system to determine whether this project consumes or owns the Design System.
